coordinates.object_orientation: Head -Y, tail +Y, up +Z. Neutral quadruped, body long axis Y.

concept.reason: Inspected primary specimen figure plus museum account sufficiently establish diagnostic form; no generated concept required.

scope: Original whole organism with long backward tubular head crest, not isolated skull or substituted species.
specimen_basis: ROM 768 holotype, Fig.1 of Bertozzo et al. doi:10.1111/joa.13363. Missing tail series, most hindlimbs and distal ischia reconstructed comparatively. Fossil death posture and pathological spinal gap are NOT normal living anatomy.

scale.basis: NHM genus-level approximate size, used as artistic adult target; not a measured ROM768 complete length.

diagnostic_targets: Long slender tubular crest extends backward over neck, curves gently down at far end. Integrate with posterior skull, not antlers or a solid fan.
Broad duckbill muzzle, long facial profile, compact eyes; mouth closed, no predator fangs.
Heavy herbivore trunk, robust hindlimbs and smaller supportive forelimbs, tapering counterbalancing tail.
Neutral healthy quadrupedal stance with tail held clear of ground. No swan-neck death pose or tripodal kangaroo stance.
uncertainties: Soft tissue, colour and exact limb/tail proportions are reconstructed; no skin-colour claim.
Crest is hollow internally but mesh may use a solid lowpoly silhouette; do not add arbitrary exposed nostril tube openings.
No asserted neck frill/web, snorkel function, crest-to-back contact or pathological back saddle.
acceptance_checks: Side view reads original long backward tube, not short strongly curved P.cyrtocristatus crest, generic crestless hadrosaur or Lambeosaurus fan.
Crest remains clear of neck/back; no visible disconnected segments or self-intersections.
Complete whole body, four integrated limbs and tail; hooflike functional toes rather than theropod raptor claws.
Default four views only, perspective may reuse preview; no copied meshes/textures.
handoff_contract: Same local directory prep/maker/QA. Maker reports fixed files/hash COMPLETE and stops. Root coordinates asynchronous private backup; retain local through integration. No new-model PR while awaiting later batch.
